title: Ilustración de Calendario
prompt:
Please generate a cute and stylish vertical (9:16) calendar illustration in a fresh and bright hand-drawn illustration style:
1. Illustration Requirements:
The character is a young, fashionable female figure with a cute and lively style, using watercolor or hand-drawn textures, with bright and soft colors.
Character features include: large eyes, round rosy cheeks, wearing exaggerated and fashionable accessories (such as sunglasses, hoop earrings, headbands, hairbands or bows, knitted hats, etc.), brightly colored clothing, lively and playful character poses, appropriately exaggerated body proportions (such as a slightly larger head and a slender waist).
Based on holidays, "suitable activities" or the season and the characteristic elements of the user's location, the character's outfit and styling description is: [{character outfit description}]
The character is located in the center or right side of the screen, leaving sufficient white space for text content.
The background is pure white, extremely simple, with no additional decorative elements, highlighting the main character and text.
2. Calendar Element Layout:
Prominent position in the top center: Gregorian calendar date number [{Gregorian date number}] (large and eye-catching font)
English month [{English month}] below the date number
On the left and right sides of the date, respectively mark the Chinese and English day of the week [{Chinese day of the week}] [{English day of the week}] and the lunar date and holidays [{Lunar date in Chinese}] [{Holiday}], with a symmetrical left-right layout and clear and elegant fonts.
3. "Suitable" Activities and Inspirational Sentences:
On the left side, display today's [suitable] activities in bold vertical text: [{suitable activities}], with a simple handwritten brush font, slightly larger, vertically arranged.
To the right of [suitable activities], arrange the corresponding inspirational and healing sentence [{inspirational sentence}] in a slightly smaller font vertically.
4. Location-Specific Elements:
Based on the user's current location or input location, appropriately incorporate local iconic elements or characteristics (such as city landmarks, climate characteristics, regional customs) into the character's clothing, accessories, or details of the illustration.
Overall Description:
All placeholder information should be retrieved and generated automatically based on user input or user information and system information.
The layout of all elements should be neat and beautiful, maintaining appropriate white space.
Text positions should be clear and easy to read, avoiding overlap or obstruction with the illustration.
